flagged.title: Muscles and Antagonistic Pairs
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly identifies the downward phase of a press-up as elbow extension, which would lose marks on movement analysis questions.

mark_affecting.quote: look at the downward phase, or elbow extension like during a press-up

flagged.title: Components of Fitness and Fitness Tests
flagged.reason: The video explicitly states that the stork stand test is performed with eyes closed, which teaches incorrect test protocol for the OCR specification where the test is done with eyes open and heel raised.

mark_affecting.quote: You stand on one leg, rest your other foot against your knee, close your eyes - yes, eyes closed - and the clock starts.

flagged.title: Principles of Training and FITT
flagged.reason: The video defines SPOR using 'Recovery' as a principle of training and combines progressive overload into one, which directly contradicts the OCR specification where Progression and Overload are separate principles and Recovery is not one of the four.

mark_affecting.quote: It stands for specificity, progressive overload, reversibility, and recovery.

flagged.title: Warm Up and Cool Down
flagged.reason: The video explicitly instructs students to memorize that OCR lists eight distinct physical benefits of a warm-up (and lists eight items), whereas the OCR specification lists seven.

mark_affecting.quote: 8. Seriously, lock this number in your brain right now. OCR lists exactly eight distinct physical benefits of warming up.
